deploybot: [migration-slot] Requesting 04/10 02:00-03:00 UTC slot for migration m-5782 (shadow index + compact backfill). Canaries=2. Ack within 10m.
Jamal: Plan: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY -> chunked backfill workers -> atomic rename under short ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. Throttle default 350 r/s.
Katie: Pin canaries to release-3.2.5-dbhotfix to avoid schema drift. If canary errors, roll back canary pin to release-3.2.4.
SRE-oncall: Adding preflight checks: replication lag, long-running txs, and leak detector. Autothrottle: if replica_lag > 25s for 90s then reduce to 150 r/s and alert #eng-sre.
Jamal: Runbook snippet:
```
-- preflight
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction';
SELECT replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication LIMIT 3;
-- progress
SELECT phase, done_chunks, total_chunks FROM migration_tracker WHERE migration_id='m-5782';
```
Katie: I'll own cutover. Smoke test: GET /api/v1/profile?email=test@x.com must return <200ms. I'll paste results.
ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required to proceed beyond canary. Auto-abort if preflight fails.
Jamal: SQL (sanitized):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS profiles_email_shadow ON profiles ((lower(email))) WITH (fillfactor=90);
-- background workers fill chunks
-- cutover: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE profiles IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX profiles_email_shadow RENAME TO profiles_email_idx; COMMIT;
```
SRE-oncall: Rollback options: 1) abort before swap -> no impact; 2) after swap -> rename old back (short lock). Documented in ops playbook.
Katie: Claiming slot and will start canary at 02:00 UTC. deploybot, start canaries and post status here.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Will post canary health updates.
